info.title: Weekdone Universal API
info.description: Weekdone is an OKR, weekly reporting, and team planning platform. This wrapper lets MindCloud read and manage Weekdone items, reports, tags, objectives, KPIs, teams, users, and company metadata through the official Weekdone API.
